subject: M-Theory numerics — kickoff and framing
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the M-Theory numerics project. Framing for anyone new: this is our pure-mathematics track — there is no dependency on measurement or user data at all, we're using our ML stack as a generic numerical engine to hunt for structure in supergravity potentials. The product story is credibility + tooling: the same vectorized optimization machinery generalizes to other stiff numerical searches in the portfolio.

Milestones (window closes 2026-07-06):
- 04-24: SUGRA_Colab loader flow working against our internal mirror, including the m_theory.zip upload path for modified modules.
- 05-29: reproduce the known critical-point catalogue on small scans.
- 06-26: large-scale scan results written up for the Q3 OKR lock that same day.

Bruno has staffing; Yara is tech lead. Compute ask coming separately from Bruno — the big scans are accelerator-hungry.

Anders
